description: This file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, responsible for updating database schema and language strings during an upgrade to version 5.8.0. It handles schema modifications, foreign key corrections, and language string updates.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for database and language updates in OrangeHRM version 5.8.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps: introspecting tables, correcting currency ID column inconsistencies, updating language strings, and changing schema where necessary.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Fixes foreign key constraints and column data types for 'currency_id' across multiple tables to ensure consistency and proper foreign key relationships.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys related to 'hs_hr_currency_type' from specified tables that conflict with current schema requirements.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops conflicting foreign key constraints identified in previous steps.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Recreates foreign keys that were dropped to restore schema integrity after modifications.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object for executing raw SQL statements.

methods.name: disableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in the database to allow schema modifications.

methods.name: enableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key checks after schema modifications are complete.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.8.0' for this migration.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for language string operations.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database to match the current migration version.
